posts.title: China's September NEV retail sales fall 12% as month-end surge narrows decline, preliminary CPCA data shows
posts.summary:
A sales surge in the final 3 days narrowed the year-on-year decline in NEV retail sales from 20% in the first 27 days.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's passenger NEV retail sales fell 12% year-on-year to 1.141 million units in September, though a late-month surge helped narrow the decline from earlier in the month.
NEVs captured a 67.1% share of total passenger vehicle retail sales, highlighting the continued shift away from gasoline-powered vehicles.
While retail sales struggled, wholesale NEV sales reached a record high for the year at 1.672 million units, representing an 11% year-on-year increase.
The CPCA noted that the broader automotive market is facing significant pressure, with gasoline-powered vehicle production and sales experiencing sharp double-digit declines.

posts.title: Geely Galaxy launches Cruiser 700 to take on BYD, GWM in off-road SUV market
posts.summary:
The limited-time price of the Cruiser 700, including a trade-in subsidy, is 169,800 yuan ($25,220), and firm orders exceeded 10,000 units within the first 12 minutes.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Geely Galaxy launched the Cruiser 700, a rugged PHEV off-road SUV, with a starting price of 169,800 yuan ($25,220) after applying various subsidies.
The vehicle achieved strong initial demand, recording over 10,000 firm orders within the first 12 minutes of its launch.
The model features a 1.5-liter turbocharged engine with electric motor configurations, offering a combined system output of up to 830 kW and a combined range of 1,770 km.
This launch marks Geely's direct entry into the competitive off-road segment currently dominated by BYD's Fang Cheng Bao and GWM's Tank.

posts.title: China proposes tighter vehicle design rules, reiterates concealed-handle ban and targets foldable screens
posts.summary:
A mandatory national standard already bans fully concealed door handles. The new draft would further link design safety assessments to vehicle approvals.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's MIIT has proposed stricter vehicle design regulations that would mandate mechanical redundancy for door handles and prohibit foldable or flexible interior displays.
The draft rules aim to enhance safety by restricting the use of 'zero-gravity' or swivel seats while a vehicle is in motion.
Automakers will face more rigorous safety assessments and testing requirements for innovative features, with non-compliant models facing potential denial of approval.
These measures reflect a regulatory push to curb safety risks associated with rapid, trend-driven design changes that may lack sufficient real-world testing.

posts.title: Xpeng completes G9L trial production in Austria ahead of Paris global premiere
posts.summary:
The G9L becomes Xpeng's fourth model to be assembled locally in Europe.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xpeng has completed trial production of its G9L flagship SUV at Magna Steyr's facility in Graz, Austria, marking its fourth model to be localized in Europe.
The G9L is scheduled for a global premiere in Paris on October 12, with plans to expand the model's availability to 64 countries and regions.
The company is utilizing contract manufacturing in Europe to scale its presence, while simultaneously preparing right-hand-drive versions for markets like Australia.

posts.title: X-energy and its helium-cooled nuclear reactors
posts.summary: X-energy is developing small modular reactors to satisfy some of the planet’s most power-hungry users: industrial manufacturers that need high temperatures to produce billions of tons of concrete, plastics, fibers, and chemicals. Solar panels and wind turbines are great at producing electricity but what heavy industry also needs is raw heat—and lots of it. The manufacture…
bullets: X-energy is developing small modular reactors (SMRs) that use helium gas as a coolant, allowing for operating temperatures high enough to decarbonize heavy industries like steel and chemical manufacturing.
The Xe-100 reactor utilizes TRISO fuel pebbles, which are designed to be corrosion-resistant and inherently safe against meltdowns during power loss.
By co-locating these reactors at industrial sites, the company aims to address the 18% of global greenhouse-gas emissions currently generated by high-temperature industrial heating.
